scripts.dump:live: tsx freqtrade/scripts/dump-indicators.ts freqtrade/fixtures/BTCUSDT-1h.json freqtrade/fixtures/BTCUSDT-1h.live.csv --mode live && tsx freqtrade/scripts/dump-indicators.ts freqtrade/fixtures/ETHUSDT-4h.json freqtrade/fixtures/ETHUSDT-4h.live.csv --mode live
